name: Beaverhead River
blurb: Tailwater below Clark Canyon Dam. Tight, weedy, and technical — drift boats more than tubes.

sections.notes: Best floating on the river. Narrow and brushy. Great trout water.
sections.distanceReview: The legacy mileage conflicts with the agency river geometry and has not been established between the intended landings. Float-time estimates are withheld until access and distance are resolved.

sections.notes: Use Barretts Station Park’s designated take-out upstream of the diversion dam. Locate the landing from shore before launching. The available tourism coordinate overlaps the dam and is not used as a landing marker.

notices.title: Take out before Barretts Diversion Dam
notices.text: Montana’s official tourism listing identifies a boat take-out at Barretts Station Park, with the diversion dam about 200 yards downstream. The dam itself is not the take-out.
